The only apparent source is the separate constant-choice step 1.1.1, which is not validated and is currently challenged: lem-maincb-error-improvement supplies only c_bar < infinity, not c_bar >= 0, so its displayed 0 <= c_bar*epsilon and the monotonicity enlargement to c0=max{1,c_bar} are unsupported. Without a valid derivation of c0 >= 1, c0 <= c0*W.L need not hold (e.g. c0=-1, W.L=2), so the claimed bound c0*epsilon <= t_3 does not follow from W.K3 >= c0*W.L.
